summary_responses.subtopic: National Park Administration, Conservation & Multi-Use Trail Regulation
summary_responses.response: The National Park Service (NPS) has amended regulations for Mammoth Cave National Park to allow bicycle use on approximately 37 miles of multi-use trails and horseback riding on the 5.4-mile Houchin Ferry North/Ollie Road. This rule, effective December 21, 2026, is part of a broader plan to enhance recreational opportunities while protecting natural and cultural resources. The rule requires public notification of designated trails and allows for the potential inclusion of electric bicycles on trails open to traditional bicycles.
